summary: Elong Power Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled October 30, 2026 (Beijing time) at its Beijing offices. The sole substantive proposal is a special resolution to deregister as a Cayman Islands exempted company and continue into the British Virgin Islands as a BVI business company, with all Class A and Class B ordinary shares redesignated one-for-one and new memorandum and articles adopted. The filing states no price, stake, premium or adviser. What to watch: EGM dissent or quorum risk and completion of the continuation.
